repos_data.description: The Vibe Coding Kit — a shareable Claude Code framework (BOOTSTRAP + Vibe Board MCP + optional VE Worker). Drop-in skills, RIPER workflow, /review-* audit family. Companion to HuntsDesk/ve-gws.
Local task-state ledger for AI coding agents. Preserve decisions, source conclusions, evidence, and checkpoints across Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP clients.
Persistent, agent-agnostic session memory for AI coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, opencode). One Markdown vault, any agent.
Local-first Rust TUI/CLI for auditing AI coding-agent sessions: cost, tokens, latency, failures, and health｜本地优先 Rust TUI/CLI，审计 AI 编程 Agent 会话的成本、Token、延迟、失败与健康度
Long-term memory for AI-coded codebases. A git blame for AI agents — but for the why. MCP server that captures the agent's reasoning live, in context, as each change is made. Local SQLite, zero deps.

Open-source coding agent memory. Records issues, attempts, fixes and decisions, then warns your agent before it repeats an approach that already failed. Native MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity and Codex. 100% local, no cloud, no telemetry. MIT.
Tracks which agent wrote which lines when multiple AI agents share one Git checkout.

Self-maintaining and persistent codebase memory for AI coding agents — a deterministic AST index plus agent-written notes that flag themselves stale when the code changes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via MCP + CLI.
Open-source team memory layer for AI coding agents — markdown files in git, user→team→org hierarchy, cross-vendor MCP server. Apache-2.0.
Terminal session manager for AI coding agents. One TUI for Claude, Gemini, OpenCode, Codex, and more.
A keyboard-first menubar app to monitor and jump between AI coding sessions — minimum setup required.

Vibe Check is a tool that provides mentor-like feedback to AI Agents, preventing tunnel-vision, over-engineering and reasoning lock-in for complex and long-horizon agent workflows. KISS your over-eager AI Agents goodbye! Effective for: Coding, Ambiguous Tasks, High-Risk tasks

repo_meta_data.description: Rollback and safety for AI coding agents and vibe coders: flag risky changes and restore project files, including uncommitted work, to their pre-session state.
